publication_status: Final committed full-seven results included; exploratory factor evidence remains separately scoped.
review_summary: All 12 listed retained commits are CLEAR in the designated review record. Review is distinct from benchmark isolation.

commits.title: Align the native Vortex reader with the Arbor revision
commits.why_needed: Moves the native reader/writer to Git Vortex 7d003295 and adapts the affected UUID/session/statistics APIs. This removes reader-version drift from the comparison.
commits.benchmark_or_validation: Revision alignment and correctness coverage; no standalone speedup measured.

commits.title: Filter Vortex layout batches before limiting Arrow output
commits.change: Filter layout batches before Arrow slicing
commits.why_needed: Keeps Vortex input work aligned with file layout, then enforces the requested Arrow output batch limit; also preserves optional view output.
commits.benchmark_or_validation: Layout toggle: 1.42x derived rate in a five-query paired SF10 screen only.

commits.title: Expose supported Iceberg Vortex tasks as a native array source
commits.change: Expose a generic Vortex array source
commits.why_needed: Lets supported Iceberg tasks retain native projections and predicates until Arrow export, with parallel ranges/selections/limits and whole-scan fallback. This is an integration API, not a DataFusion dependency in Iceberg.
commits.benchmark_or_validation: Part of the 1.182x full 22-query native-source bundle; not isolated from cache/adapter changes.

commits.title: Reuse opened Vortex files on the table IO runtime
commits.change: Reuse immutable file handles on Table IO
commits.why_needed: Caches up to 128 opened immutable Vortex files while keeping predicate/pruning state query-local. Explicit Table IO ownership preserves driver lifetime when plans move between runtimes.
commits.benchmark_or_validation: Included in the native-source bundle; no cache-only timing claim. Runtime/lifetime and cache correctness tests support it.

commits.title: Remove redundant residuals for fully enforced Iceberg predicates
commits.why_needed: Certifies only complete approved predicates on required, default-free fields across schema history and unpartitioned history. DataFusion can then omit duplicate evaluation and hidden filter-only output columns.
commits.benchmark_or_validation: Paired full 22-query Exact toggle: +2.8% Zstd and +3.8% LZ4_RAW derived rate.

commits.title: Support consistent view types and Vortex layout batches
commits.change: Expose consistent views and layout controls
commits.why_needed: Adds optional stable Arrow view types across both formats and forwards layout batching. Canonical output remains the selected default; matching native/dev Vortex pins preserve compatibility.
commits.benchmark_or_validation: Layout evidence is the five-query screen. View types remain opt-in; measurements did not justify enabling them globally.

commits.title: Use native Vortex expressions for supported Iceberg scans
commits.change: Bridge the official DataFusion Vortex source
commits.why_needed: Connects the generic native API to DataFusion projection/filter pushdown and shared scan scheduling. Conservative conversion leaves incompatible semantics in DataFusion and permits only proved decimal arithmetic.
commits.benchmark_or_validation: Supported by the 1.182x paired full 22-query native-source bundle and real-file correctness tests; not a per-hunk timing attribution.

commits.title: Publish the reviewed native scan patch extension
commits.change: Publish the reproducible native patch extension
commits.why_needed: Exports the four new native commits alongside the original nine, with ordered replay hashes and correctly scoped historical tree-equality proof.
commits.benchmark_or_validation: Reproducibility and packaging; no runtime speedup attributed.

commits.title: Enable benchmarked exact filters and native Vortex scans
commits.why_needed: Enables Exact predicates, Vortex layout batching and the supported native Vortex path. Canonical Arrow output stays default; unsupported tables retain the existing reader fallback.
commits.benchmark_or_validation: Selects configurations supported by the Exact/layout/native studies. Default activation is validated together with the following parallelism guard.

commits.title: Preserve parallel Vortex outputs under limit and sort rewrites
commits.change: Preserve parallel scans through optimizer rewrites
commits.why_needed: Keeps at least two source output partitions under limit/sort/fetch rewrites; global ordering and limits remain in DataFusion. This closes a gap in the consumer parallelism contract.
commits.benchmark_or_validation: Correctness/plan regression coverage for target counts 1 and 4; no standalone throughput claim. Included in the final committed executable.

commits.title: Pin ColdFusion to native Vortex scan integration
commits.change: Pin the benchmark consumer to the native bridge
commits.why_needed: Updates the harness dependency and lock graph to the reviewed public/native integration while preserving unrelated Apache Iceberg and DataFusion pins.
commits.benchmark_or_validation: Dependency alignment for matched runs; not individually benchmarked.

commits.title: Expose ColdFusion scan controls in benchmark runner
commits.why_needed: Adds explicit scan-option controls and untimed post-preparation settling, allowing reproducible on/off comparisons with the existing Arbor and Iceberg lanes.
commits.benchmark_or_validation: Enables controlled factors and the final full-seven run; instrumentation is not itself an attributed speedup.

exact.primary_metric: Average across two runs of the sum of per-query arithmetic sample means

native_bundle.timing_isolation: Whole native-source versus Arrow-reader configuration; no allocation between native API, cache, converter, adapter, or individual commits.

views_layout.reason: Views remain available as an opt-in capability; measured workload behavior did not justify a global view default. Layout screen evidence is recorded separately.
